subject.title: Flaky tests on Windows/WSL: timeouts and ENOENT in pi-tools workspace-paths & safe-bins

question: Should maintainers require fresh WSL/Testbox reproduction before queueing a narrow repair for the agent-tools workspace-paths and safe-bins tests?
rationale: The source shape still matches the report, but current labels and prior review ask for maintainer/live-repro review before another automated fix PR.

options.title: Require fresh WSL proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open and require a WSL/Testbox run or explicit maintainer confirmation before queueing the narrow test-harness repair.

options.title: Allow a source-backed repair now
options.body: Queue a narrow test-only repair using the existing helpers and WSL guard surface without waiting for live reproduction.

options.title: Resolve only the linked fs-safe PR
options.body: Let the unrelated hardlink-test PR proceed on its own while keeping this issue open for the reported agent-tools tests.

recommendation.title: Require fresh WSL proof first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and require a WSL/Testbox run or explicit maintainer confirmation before queueing the narrow test-harness repair.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history on the affected test files and authored the prior review that set the narrow fix boundary.
